So far no other species of Luridiblatta had been found within the distribution area of L. vesiculosa. II. The trivittata- species group 1. Group-specific characters Male T 6. Mesal part of anterior border slightly more produced than in the preceding group, transversal ridge mesally interrupted or completely missing, near the lateral borders with a pair of small deepenings (Fig. 1 B, C; for more details see description under characters of the genus).
